Are my files uploaded?

No account is needed for viewing, compare, capture, or OCR. Sign in for cloud Widgets

or purchases.

Viewing and local tools run on your Mac. Only the media you submit to a cloud Widget is

uploaded.

Is Pro a subscription?

What if a task fails?

No. Pro is a one-time purchase with lifetime free updates and no automatic renewals.

All failed Widget tasks refund credits in full automatically, including provider,

network, and invalid-input failures.

What stays free after the trial?

How do I pay?

Viewing, compare, capture, OCR, and credit-based cloud Widgets. The remaining local

tools require Pro.

Choose a product in the app. The checkout shows available payment methods for your

currency.
